dimensions.assessment: Affects university researchers, students, postdoctoral fellows, federal agencies, and institutions participating in AI workforce and research programs.
dimensions.evidence: Director of the National Science Foundation may support graduate and postdoctoral research fellowships for students and postdoctoral researchers from across disciplines

dimensions.assessment: Establishes training, fellowship opportunities, and standardized workforce classification frameworks without mandating economy-wide private mandates.
dimensions.evidence: develop fundamental reference resources for describing and sharing information regarding work related to artificial intelligence to address workforce gaps

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes programmatic activities and awards through NSF and NIST but does not specify total new appropriations figures.
dimensions.evidence: The Director of the National Science Foundation may make awards for the development and hosting of intra- or inter-institutional workshops

dimensions.assessment: Amends the National Artificial Intelligence Initiative Act of 2020 and the National Institute of Standards and Technology Act.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the National Artificial Intelligence Initiative Act of 2020 to facilitate the growth of multidisciplinary teams

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent agency authorities and ongoing frameworks, including publication and reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the development of the artificial intelligence workforce framework... make such framework publicly available

missing_information: Total authorized funding or specific appropriation amounts for the new fellowships and NIST framework activities
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes workforce development programs, fellowships, research workshops, and standard framework definitions related to trustworthy artificial intelligence across federal science agencies.
